People (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.

once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 11, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE II OF 1985
ORDINANCE II OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1985]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing ;
5. Amendment of section 11,
Act LXXXV of 1976.-In the said Act, in section 11, for subsections (1) and
(2) the following shall be substituted namely :--
"(1) As
soon as the President makes an announcement of the date or dates on which the
polls shall, be taken, the Election Commission shall, by notification in the
official Gazette, call upon a constituency to elect a representative or
representatives and appoint-
(a) the last
date for making nominations, which shall be the sixth day after the date of
publication of the notification or, if that day is a public holiday the next
succeeding day which is not a public holiday ;
(b) the dates
for the scrutiny of nominations, which shall be the two days immediately
following the last date for making nominations or, if that day is a public
holiday, the next succeeding day which is not a public holiday ;
(c) the last
date for the withdrawal of candidatures, which shall be the day following the
second date for the scrutiny of nominations, or, if that day is a public
holiday, the next succeeding day which is not a public holiday ;
(d) the last
date for filing of appeals against acceptance or rejection of nominations,
which shall be the day following the second date for the scrutiny of
nominations or, if that day is a public holiday, the next succeeding day which
is not a public holiday ;
(e) the last
date for decision of appeals, which shall be the second day following the last
date for filing of appeals or, if that day is a public holiday, the next
succeeding day which is not a public holiday ;
(f) the last
date for publication of the revised list of candidates, which shall be the
second day following the last date for decision of appeals ; and
(g) the date or
dates on which a poll shall, if necessary be taken, which or the first of which
shall be a date not earlier than the twenty-second day after the publication of
the revised list of candidates."

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 12, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE II OF 1985
ORDINANCE II OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1985]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing ;
6. Amendment of section 12,
Act LXXXV of 1976.-In the said Act, for section 12 the following shall be
substituted, namely.:-
"12. Nomination
for election.-(1) Any fifty electors of a constituency may nominate a duly
qualified person to be a member for that constituency.
(2) Every
nomination shall be made by a separate nomination paper in the prescribed form
which shall be signed by all the fifty proposers and shall contain a
declaration signed by the candidate that he has consented to the nomination and
that he is not subject to any disqualification for being elected as a member.
(3) Every
nomination paper shall be delivered by any of the prosposers to the Returning
Officer, or his nominee, who shall acknowledge receipt of the nomination paper
specifying the date and time of receipt.
(4) A person may
be nominated in the same constituency by not more than five nomination papers.
(5) If any
person subscribes to the nomination of more than one candi date, all nomination
papers to which he has subscribed shall be void.
(6) The
Returning Officer shall assign a serial number to every nomina tion paper and
endorse thereon the name of the person presenting it, and the date and time of
its receipt, and inform such person of the time and place at which he shall
hold scrutiny.
(7) The
Returning Officer shall cause to be affixed at a conspicuous place in his
office a notice of every nomination paper received by him containing the
particulars of the candidate as shown in the nomination paper."

Whereas it is expedient further

7. Amendment of section 14,
Act LXXXV of 1976.-In the said Act, in section 14,-
(a) in
subsection (1) for the comma and words ", proposers and secon ders"
the words "and proposers" shall be substituted;
(b) in
subsection (3),-
(i) for clause
(b) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(b) any of
the proposers is not qualified to subscribe to the nomina tion paper;";
(ii) for clause
(d) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(d) the
signature of any of the proposers is not genuine; "; and
(iii) in the

(c) for

"(4) The

or rejecting it and shall, in the case of rejection, record brief reasons
therefore;

against the decision of the Returning Officer under subsection (4) shall lie to
the Commission or, in the case of a constituency within the territorial
jurisdiction of a Bench of a High Court, to a Judge of the High Court nominated
by the President in consultation with the Commissioner and the Chief Justice of
the High Court, and shall be summarily decided within such time as may be
notified by the Commission and any order passed thereon shall be final." ;
and
(d) in
subsection (7), after the word "radio", the words "or
television" shall be inserted.
